name: B10-0162/2024 (Renew) – EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for tougher action against the ships Russia uses to sell its oil and avoid sanctions. It wants more of these ships, and the companies behind them, added to the sanctions list. It also wants a full ban on buying Russian oil and gas, and on letting these unsafe, uninsured ships into European waters. The Parliament is giving its opinion; it does not itself change the law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU to add more ships to the sanctions list and ban Russian oil and gas.
- **Who it affects:** Russia's oil trade, the companies and countries helping it, and EU ports and coastal waters.
- **What happens next:** The EU's member governments decide whether to adopt these measures in the next sanctions package.
